name: Yvette Clarke
page_title: Yvette Clarke's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NY) - District 9

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

"When extreme MAGA Republicans celebrated a successful attack against our reproductive rights with the overturning of Roe v. Wade, House Democrats got to work. We are fighting right now to restore our freedoms and secure access to abortion, birth control, and fertility services."
Voted in favor of HR 8296: "Women's Health Protection Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 8297: "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "On today's 88th anniversary of #SocialSecurity, I’m proud to stand against every extreme MAGA Republican determined to slash this critical lifeline. @HouseDemocrats will always remain committed to securing this program's future and ensuring our seniors can retire with dignity."

"Working Americans pay into #SocialSecurity with each and every paycheck – except for the ultra-wealthy, who stop paying this weekend for the rest of the year. It’s time to #ScrapTheCap and enhance Social Security benefits for the first time in half a century."
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 100% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Billionaires and big corporations have a responsibility to pay their fair share — just like everyone else. House Democrats are putting a stop to unfair tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy and doing our part to prevent billionaire tax cheats from ripping off working Americans."
In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket? "Yes"
Rated 14% by National Taxpayers Union
Voted against HR 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "As we remember the life of our dear brother #GeorgeFloyd on the first anniversary of his death, our commitment to comprehensive police reform — inclusive of ending qualified immunity — is stronger than ever. It is beyond time for action; it is beyond time for change!"

"The George Floyd #JusticeInPolicing Act holds officers ACCOUNTABLE. They must be responsible to the communities that they swore to protect and serve. It’s time to change the culture of policing in America. It’s time to pass the George Floyd #JusticeInPolicing Act."
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "As SCOTUS hears arguments in #JohnsonVGrantsPass today, we can never forget that housing is a human right. Cruelly punishing the unhoused will not solve the housing crisis – our only way forward is meaningful policy change centered in compassion, human dignity and affordability."

"Celebrating today’s announcement from @HUDgov that the Housing Trust Fund will deliver New York communities more than $34 million in our fight to end the affordable housing crisis – key funding that will aid our existing efforts to combat homelessness throughout New York."

"It's #FairHousingMonth and I’m proud to support @HouseDemocrats’ continued fight against housing discrimination. Every family in every neighborhood deserves access to safe, decent, and affordable housing!"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "As the market reaches new all-time highs and inflation falls to its lowest level in three years, we can tie a straight line from these wins to the policies of @POTUS and @HouseDemocrats. And our work to make life more affordable for American families isn’t close to finished."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of HR 7688: "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by National Education Association
"Applauding @POTUS for standing by his principles with his veto of the GOP’s bill to decimate his plan for student debt relief. He and the Democrats are in agreement – we need to #CancelStudentDebt!"

"Despite already canceling more student loan debt than any president in history, @POTUS’ work to give borrowers life-changing debt relief is far from over. I’m celebrating today’s announcement that could see significant loan debt cancelled for 30 million Americans."

"MAGA Republicans are fighting to take desperately needed student debt relief from more than 20 million of their own constituents – and the cruelty is the point. The GOP wants to steal the relief you earned, and I refuse to stand by while they try."

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "Congressman John Lewis committed his life to fighting inequality in all forms. Two years ago today, the House passed the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to uphold & restore key protections of the Voting Rights Act of 1965. To honor his legacy, our work must go on."
Rated 94% by Common Cause
Voted in favor of HR 4: "John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act of 2021"
Voted in favor of HR 5746 "Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act"

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Health care is a human right – full stop. Ours is the richest nation in the history of the world, yet 28 million Americans still lack health insurance and any access to healthcare. And that’s unacceptable. It’s time for #MedicareForAll."
"We need universal programs to make sure every American is cared for. That means paid family and medical leave, child care, and home- and community-based services."
Voted in favor of HR 1425: "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Enhancement Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Twenty-six years after the FMLA was signed, people need #paidleave, and a national plan like the #FAMILYAct would benefit them and their families, businesses and the economy. #Paidleave means everyone wins."
"We need universal programs to make sure every American is cared for. That means paid family and medical leave, child care, and home- and community-based services."
Voted in favor of HR 6201 "Families First Coronavirus Response Act"

"We made history by lowering health care costs and prescription drug prices, investing in our nation’s infrastructure, and creating better-paying jobs."
Voted in favor of HR 3 "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"
Voted in favor of HR 6833 "The Affordable Insulin Now Act"
